newsitem.title: GERMANY: GERMAN AND CZECH POLITICIANS AIM FOR QUICK GOAL.
newsitem.headline: GERMAN AND CZECH POLITICIANS AIM FOR QUICK GOAL.

text.p: German and Czech politicians will abandon their smoky rooms for the soccer pitch at the weekend hoping for a quick goal -- a declaration of reconciliation between their two countries.

Germany's opposition Greens party said on Thursday their parliamentary soccer side would travel to Prague to take on a select team of Czech politicians including Education Minister Ivan Pilip on Sunday.
"To put some movement back into the negotiations over a German-Czech declaration, the Green parliamentary group is going down new roads," the party said in a statement.

Bonn and Prague have for months been trying to hammer out a text intended to set aside lingering resentment over both the Nazi invasion of Czechoslovakia and the expulsion of millions of ethnic Germans from the country after World War Two. Chancellor Helmut Kohl says the declaration will be ready this year.
The Greens said the match was not intended as a re-run of this year's European championship final in England, where Germany beat the Czech Republic 2-1.
